brief: A convincing grayscale dragon in flight on a plain background. Establish articulated wings, connected anatomy, a banking gesture and coherent value masses. No landscape, fire, colour, surface texture or image generation. The foundation needs human judgment before any decorative stage.

references.observation: Viewed the anatomical photograph: the arm has an elbow and wrist before the long finger fan; finger tips form unequal scallops, and the two wings are projected at different angles.
references.application: Use separate shoulder, elbow and wrist landmarks; radiate digits from the wrist and vary the foreshortening of the two wings. Do not trace the photograph or copy pixels.

references.observation: The anatomy explanation describes the wing as elongated arm and finger bones supporting a membrane, with a separate clawed thumb.
references.application: Construct a continuous arm chain and a free thumb. The six-limbed dragon is invented anatomy; bat references inform the wing mechanism, not the full creature.

stages.goal: Compare genuinely different flying gestures before committing to detail

criteria.description: The spine and wings suggest a single readable flight action
Wings, head, limbs and tail have readable silhouettes and negative spaces

stages.goal: Resolve construction and values; request human judgment before advancing

criteria.description: Shoulder, elbow, wrist and finger chains connect plausibly; skull, neck, torso and limbs form coherent masses
Large grayscale light and shadow masses explain overlap and volume without texture
The plain drawing is convincing enough to develop, without colour or scenery rescuing it
